subject: E-1100: token rejected on macOS
body:
Hi, I'm using SyncVault 4.2.6 on macOS 15.3. Starting
Tuesday, the moment I open the app a dialog reads "E-1100:
authentication token rejected".

There was a company-wide forced password reset last week. I
changed mine on the laptop but the app never asked again.

Before writing in I tried restarting the machine; same error
afterwards.

Kenji Sato -- Oakline Partners. Appreciate any pointers.
